Hi Alice / Bob — thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

1) Success criteria (draft):
- 95th percentile latency for typical 1k-token workflow < 400ms
- Mean cost per session under your target of $0.35/session
- 95% of outputs meet CLS internal accuracy metric (we'll map to your clinical acceptance criteria)
- No data leaves your VPC during trial (Private deployment option)

2) Proposed POC evaluation plan:
- Week 0: spin up dedicated trial environment (Redwood Dedicated or Private per your security ask)
- Weeks 1-2: ingest sample dataset + run synthetic load; measure latency/cost
- Weeks 3-4: run seeded production-like cases from your team and collect qualitative QA feedback
- Final readout: 30-45 minute exec summary + demo, decision (go/no-go) and next steps for contracting

3) Ownership:
- Redwood: Marcus (tech lead) + Hannah (integration/SE) for infra, Neha for CS readiness
- Acme: Alice (product) + Bob (procurement)

4) Next actions (I’ll take care of items in bold):
- **Share POC success criteria spreadsheet** (attached) — please edit with your clinical thresholds by Fri 6/18
- Adam on your side to share a small sample dataset (PII redacted) — target date Mon 6/21
- **Schedule final readout window** — proposed week of 6/28; share availability
- Marcus & Hannah to confirm infra sizing options and cost estimates by 6/17

I’m attaching a short POC evaluation plan and the success criteria workbook. Let me know if any of the above needs changing. If that timeline looks good I’ll circulate a calendar hold for the final readout and loop in procurement for contract timing.
